name: upnote-mcp-win
description: Windows UpNote live and partial editing over local CDP, with backups and sync checks.
long_description: Independent Windows fork of bellx2/upnote-mcp, maintained by ten9miq. Reads use read-only SQLite; creation uses UpNote URLs. Opt-in CDP edits call the running app's internal save action, preserve note IDs and check editor reflection plus fresh app sync acknowledgement. Internal APIs are unsupported and checked for compatibility. Not affiliated with UpNote. Other-device receipt is not verified. Direct SQLite editing remains an advanced fallback.
